eyebrow: The problem: build tools that outlive the build
code:
FROM python:3.12
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y build-essential
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install -r requirements.txt  # compiler now permanent
COPY app/ ./app/
CMD ["python", "app/main.py"]
caption: The compiler toolchain ships in every container, unused after install.

code:
FROM python:3.12 AS builder
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y build-essential
RUN pip install --prefix=/install -r requirements.txt

FROM python:3.12-slim
COPY --from=builder /install /usr/local
COPY app/ ./app/
caption: Only what COPY --from explicitly asks for survives into the final image.

code:
Single-stage:  python:3.12 + build-essential + deps + app  ~1.2GB
Multi-stage:   python:3.12-slim + deps (copied) + app        ~400MB
caption: A smaller image pulls faster — which matters for Chapter 4's autoscaling.
